The bit each station reads, in the frame its rung runs in (chapter 10). During the dwell, bit n of a head register is the bottle standing n + 1 stops past its sensor; after the shift (Dwell.DN), the bottle n stops past it.

StationxExistLargeBrokenRejectFrame
Filler440765—after the shift

End-of-line check (LS11)124026252413during the dwell

The four registers are DINT[2], 48 bits long, shifted by the four BSLs of step 4 on Dwell.DN. Reject takes Cam_Bad, the camera’s verdict, so its bits count from the camera.
